Project.description: A Project represents a cloud-native application composed of multiple components in OpenChoreo.

Component.description: A Component represents a deployable unit of an application in OpenChoreo.

WorkflowRun.description: A WorkflowRun represents a single execution instance of a Workflow in OpenChoreo.

Workload.description: A Workload defines the runtime specification for a Component in OpenChoreo, including container configuration, network endpoints, and dependencies on other services.

Resource.description: A Resource represents a developer-declared dependency on managed infrastructure (database, queue, cache, object store) provisioned through a ResourceType or ClusterResourceType template.

DataPlane.description: A DataPlane represents a Kubernetes cluster where application workloads are deployed.

ClusterDataPlane.description: A ClusterDataPlane is a cluster-scoped variant of DataPlane that represents a Kubernetes cluster where application workloads are deployed.

WorkflowPlane.description: A WorkflowPlane represents the infrastructure layer responsible for executing workflow workloads in OpenChoreo.

ClusterWorkflowPlane.description: A ClusterWorkflowPlane is a cluster-scoped variant of WorkflowPlane that represents the infrastructure layer responsible for executing workflow workloads in OpenChoreo.

ObservabilityPlane.description: An ObservabilityPlane represents the infrastructure layer responsible for collecting, storing, and analyzing observability data (metrics, logs, and traces) from OpenChoreo workloads.

ClusterObservabilityPlane.description: A ClusterObservabilityPlane is a cluster-scoped variant of ObservabilityPlane that represents the infrastructure layer responsible for collecting, storing, and analyzing observability data (metrics, logs, and traces) from OpenChoreo workloads.

ComponentType.description: A ComponentType is a platform-defined template that determines how components are deployed and what resources are generated for them.

ClusterComponentType.description: A ClusterComponentType is a cluster-scoped variant of ComponentType that defines reusable deployment templates available across all namespaces.

Trait.description: A Trait represents a cross-cutting concern that can be attached to components to add additional capabilities like persistent storage, observability, security policies, or service mesh integration.

ClusterTrait.description: A ClusterTrait is a cluster-scoped variant of Trait that defines reusable cross-cutting concerns available across namespaces.

ResourceType.description: A ResourceType is a platform-defined template that governs how managed infrastructure (databases, queues, caches, object stores) is provisioned on the data plane and exposed to consumers.

ClusterResourceType.description: A ClusterResourceType is the cluster-scoped variant of ResourceType.

ProjectType.description: A ProjectType is the platform-engineer-defined infrastructure template for a project.

ClusterProjectType.description: A ClusterProjectType is the cluster-scoped sibling of ProjectType.

Workflow.description: A Workflow is a platform engineer-defined template for running automation tasks in OpenChoreo.

ClusterWorkflow.description: A ClusterWorkflow is a cluster-scoped variant of Workflow that defines reusable automation templates available across all namespaces.

SecretReference.description: A SecretReference defines a mapping between external secret store entries and Kubernetes Secrets.

DeploymentPipeline.description: A DeploymentPipeline defines the promotion paths for deploying applications across different environments in OpenChoreo.

Environment.description: An Environment represents a runtime context (e.g., dev, test, staging, production) where workloads are deployed and executed.

ReleaseBinding.description: A ReleaseBinding represents an environment-specific deployment of a Component.

ResourceReleaseBinding.description: A ResourceReleaseBinding pins a specific ResourceRelease to an Environment and carries per-environment overrides for the referenced ResourceType template.

ProjectReleaseBinding.description: A ProjectReleaseBinding pins a ProjectRelease to an Environment, owns the cell namespace for that project and environment pair, and applies the project-type resources from the inlined snapshot to that namespace.

ObservabilityAlertRule.description: An ObservabilityAlertRule defines a rule for monitoring runtime observability data (metrics or logs) and triggering alerts when specific conditions are met.

ObservabilityAlertsNotificationChannel.description: An ObservabilityAlertsNotificationChannel defines a destination for alert notifications.

AuthzRole.description: An AuthzRole defines a namespace-scoped authorization role containing a set of permitted actions.

ClusterAuthzRole.description: A ClusterAuthzRole defines a cluster-scoped authorization role containing a set of permitted actions.

AuthzRoleBinding.description: An AuthzRoleBinding connects a subject (identified by a JWT claim-value pair) to one or more roles within a namespace.

ClusterAuthzRoleBinding.description: A ClusterAuthzRoleBinding connects a subject (identified by a JWT claim-value pair) to one or more ClusterAuthzRole resources, granting or denying the roles' permissions.

ComponentRelease.description: A ComponentRelease represents an immutable snapshot of a component's configuration at a specific point in time in OpenChoreo.

ResourceRelease.description: A ResourceRelease is an immutable snapshot of a Resource and the referenced ResourceType or ClusterResourceType at the moment it was cut.

ProjectRelease.description: A ProjectRelease is an immutable snapshot of a Project and its referenced ProjectType (or ClusterProjectType) at a point in time.

RenderedRelease.description: A RenderedRelease represents the actual deployment of application resources to a target plane (DataPlane or ObservabilityPlane) in OpenChoreo.
